messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

prompt.system: You are a coding agent working inside one small workspace directory. Use the tools to read what is there and change it. Read before you edit. Make the smallest change that satisfies the task, and do not weaken any test to do it. When the work is done, reply with a short summary and no tool calls.

response.text: The bug is on line 5: `items.slice(start, start + perPage - 1)` uses `perPage - 1` as the end index, which excludes the last item of each page. It should be `start + perPage` to include all `perPage` items.
